# L5 refit `yosys-nextpnr`

Generated by `python -m hw_dse.synth.recalibrate`. New calibration: `src/hw_dse/models/calibration_artix7_refit_yosys-nextpnr.yaml` (fitted on 39 points). The default cost model is unchanged (`artix7-xc7a35t-vivado2025.2-2anchor-v1`).

## Constants

| constant | M1 (2 anchors) | refit (global) |
|---|---|---|
| c_arith | 1.0537 | 0.9693 |
| c_mux | 0.7541 | 0.8488 |
| c_ff | 1.0089 | 0.9874 |
| t_logic_ns | 0.8842 | 0.6797 |
| t_mux_ns | 1.1313 | 1.0002 |

Per-family overrides: `iterative`: c_arith=0.9277, c_ff=1.0274, t_logic_ns=0.9656, `pipelined`: c_arith=0.9714, c_ff=0.9522, t_logic_ns=0.6670, `pipelined_m`: c_arith=0.8796, c_ff=0.9489, t_logic_ns=0.8836

Tool corrections (measured ≈ factor × model, Vivado = 1): `vivado`: LUT ×1.000, FF ×1.000, path ×1.000; `yosys+nextpnr-xilinx`: LUT ×1.141, FF ×1.053, path ×1.446

Fit: every tool carries equal total weight; per-family overrides only for c_arith, c_ff and t_logic_ns, for families with >= 9 points. Vivado anchors used: `iterative:data_width=16,n_iter=14,angle_guard=0,frac_guard=0,rounding=trunc`
